adjudication_records.issue_text: quarkus/runtime/src/main/java/org/keycloak/quarkus/runtime/compatibility/CompatibilityResult.java:31 — RECREATE_UPGRADE_EXIT_CODE changed from 4 to 3, breaking the documented CLI exit-code contract for `update-compatibility` relied on by external orchestration scripts/operators

adjudication.rationale: The diff does change `CompatibilityResult.RECREATE_UPGRADE_EXIT_CODE` from 4 to 3 and introduces a new `FEATURE_DISABLED = 4`. This is a backward-incompatible change in the CLI’s exit-code behavior (previously “recreate required” would have been 4), which can affect external scripts/operators. However, the diff also shows this is intentional (comment about picocli exit codes + new feature-disabled case + docs/tests updated to use the feature flag), so it’s more of a compatibility/release-note concern than a verifiable correctness defect within the PR itself.

adjudication_records.issue_text: operator/src/test/java/org/keycloak/operator/testsuite/integration/UpgradeTest.java:115 — setEnabledFeatures(List.of(...)) unconditionally replaces the whole enabled-features list rather than appending, so if kc.getSpec().getFeatureSpec() already had other enabled features they would be silently dropped

adjudication.rationale: In `UpgradeTest.createInitialDeployment`, the code sets `kc.getSpec().getFeatureSpec().setEnabledFeatures(List.of(Profile.Feature.ROLLING_UPDATES.getKey()))` without merging with any existing enabled-features list. If `getFeatureSpec()` was already non-null and had other enabled features, this would overwrite them. The diff does not show any existing features being set before this call in this helper, so it’s not a verifiable functional defect here, but it is a concrete, diff-grounded concern about potentially dropping preconfigured test features.

adjudication_records.issue_text: quarkus/tests/integration/src/test/java/org/keycloak/it/cli/dist/UpdateCommandDistTest.java:48 — testFeatureNotEnabled only asserts the error message text and never asserts cliResult.exitCode() equals CompatibilityResult.FEATURE_DISABLED (4), so the new exit-code gating behavior is unverified.

adjudication.rationale: The diff adds new behavior to exit with a specific code when the `rolling-updates` preview feature is disabled: both `UpdateCompatibilityCheck.run()` and `UpdateCompatibilityMetadata.run()` call `picocli.exit(CompatibilityResult.FEATURE_DISABLED)` (new constant `FEATURE_DISABLED = 4` in `CompatibilityResult`). However, the newly added integration test `testFeatureNotEnabled` in `UpdateCommandDistTest` only asserts the error message text and does not assert the process exit code equals 4, so the new exit-code contract is not verified by tests.
